title: 라면 봉지 읽기: 물은 얼마나, 몇 분 끓여요?
objective: By the end, you can read the 조리법 on a Korean ramen package and find how much water to use, what to put in and when, and how many minutes to cook or wait.
summary: Learners read the cooking directions on a ramen pack and a cup-ramen lid to find the water amount, the order of steps, and the cooking time.
note: The labels on this sheet are examples. Real amounts and times are different for each product.

task.title: Read and answer
task.line: Read each label part, then write, order, choose, or mark the answer.

steps.ko: 물이 끓으면 면과 분말스프, 건더기스프를 넣습니다.
steps.en: When it boils, add the noodles and both soup packets.
Adding green onion or egg makes it tastier.
Open the lid up to the dotted line.
Pour boiling water up to the fill line.
Close the lid and eat after 3 minutes.

items.text: The part of the package that tells you how to cook.
Add something to the pot or cup.
The dry block of noodles in the pack.
The powder packet that gives the soup its taste.
The small packet of dried vegetables.
The paper top of a cup ramen.
The line inside the cup that shows how much water to pour.
Pour water into a cup. It changes to 부어요, 부으세요.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Find three things first: the water (mL or 컵), the time (분, 초), and what to put in (넣습니다). 약 means 'about': 약 3컵 = about 3 cups. Labels use -ㅂ니다 and -세요 to give instructions.
전자레인지 사용 금지 means 'Do not use a microwave.' Packages write 스프, but the standard spelling is 수프. Both mean the soup packet.

exercises: Read the label and answer in Korean: 「물 500mL를 끓인 후 면과 스프를 넣고 5분간 더 끓입니다.」 ① 물을 얼마나 끓여요? ② 면을 넣고 몇 분 더 끓여요?
Put the cup-ramen steps in order: (가) 3분 후에 드세요. (나) 뜨거운 물을 표시선까지 부으세요. (다) 뚜껑을 반쯤 여세요. (라) 물을 붓기 전에 스프를 넣으세요.
Choose the right word: ① 물이 (끓으면 / 부으면) 면을 넣으세요. ② 컵에 뜨거운 물을 (끓이세요 / 부으세요). ③ 매운맛이 싫어요? 그러면 분말스프를 조금만 (넣으세요 / 여세요).
Read the cup-ramen lid and write O (true) or X (false): 「끓는 물을 안쪽 표시선까지 붓고 뚜껑을 덮어 3분 후에 드세요. 전자레인지 사용 금지」 ① 3분 기다려요. ② 전자레인지에 넣어도 돼요. ③ 차가운 물을 부어요. ④ 물을 붓고 뚜껑을 덮어요.
Which packet is it? Write 분말스프 or 건더기스프: ① 파, 당근, 버섯이 들어 있어요. ② 이 가루를 넣으면 국물이 매워요.
answers: ① 끓으면 ② 부으세요 ③ 넣으세요
① O ② X ③ X ④ O
